name: Desegovia
source:
Current queen of the kingdom of Desegovia.

Her true nature is a twisted, wicked woman steeped in desire who plots to rule the country. Arrogant, greedy, jealous, slothful, short-tempered, a glutton, and on top of that a sex maniac, as if every human vice had been boiled down into one person.

Taken a liking to by the Three Greater Demons, she succeeds in contracting them as her servants. With their help she schemes her way onto the queen’s throne, then poisons the king and usurps the kingdom.

One day, when she asks the Magic Mirror to confirm her own beauty, she discovers Rachel.

[From the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/snowwhite.html]official website[/url]]
